open_points.subject: scope of the personal-data disclosure guarantee for direct service access
open_points.text: “Personal data — values of class `personal_data` reach an agent only as digest and class; the owner alone reads them.” and A07’s “no agent ever holds it” conflict with “the kernel neither gives nor checks [an agent’s direct service access], and its personal-data promise (K-14) covers what the kernel itself returns.”
open_points.question: Does the prohibition on agents receiving personal data apply globally, including direct access to microservices, or only to values returned through the kernel surface?
options: It applies only to kernel disclosures; direct-service disclosure is governed outside the kernel.
It applies globally, so services and the owner must prevent direct agent access to personal-data values.
open_points.default_guess: Treat K-14 as governing only kernel disclosures, because the changed exclusion says so explicitly.
